description.value: Circle K is an international convenience store and fuel station chain with a location on Jacklin Road in the western Victoria area. This location offers fresh grab-and-go food, hot roller grill items, coffee, and public restrooms under one roof. It is a practical resupply stop for cyclists passing through the Langford/Colwood corridor.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The Circle K store locator page confirms this is a real, operating convenience store and fuel station at 3198 Jacklin Road, Victoria, BC V9C 3H5, with phone +12504744980. The website explicitly lists services including Fresh Food Fast, Coffee, Roller Grill, Public Restrooms, and Lottery, providing direct evidence for several amenity fields. OSM tags (shop=convenience, brand=Circle K) are consistent with the website content; bike-specific amenities (rack, pump, charging) are not mentioned anywhere.
concerns: The store locator page title reads 'Petrol station at 3198 JACKLIN ROAD, VICTORIA, United States' — the country label is incorrect (this is Canada, V9C 3H5). Appears to be a website display bug, not a location error.
OSM record contains no address or phone tags; address and phone were sourced entirely from the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, publicly accessible convenience store and fuel station confirmed by the Circle K store locator. Practical resupply point for touring cyclists.
